recognize_zh: 中央右側一顆細胞在灰粉色細胞質內有兩個小而緻密的圓核，是雙核的晚期紅血球母細胞（binucleated erythroblast）；背景紅血球大小不一，含卵圓形大紅血球、靶形紅血球與棘狀紅血球，符合巨母紅血球性貧血的紅系發育異常。
features: Binucleate late (orthochromatic) erythroblast with two small, round, pyknotic nuclei in grey-pink cytoplasm
Adjacent small cell with a dense irregular nucleus and ragged cytoplasmic projections
Background anisopoikilocytosis with oval macrocytes and scattered target cells
Thin area of smear dominated by mature red cells
describe_en: Smear shows a thin, red-cell-dominated area with marked anisopoikilocytosis including oval macrocytes, target cells and echinocytes. A binucleate late erythroblast with two equal, condensed nuclei is present, adjacent to a small cell with a dense irregular nucleus and frayed cytoplasm. Other precursor stages are not included in this field, so the sample could be either a thin aspirate area or blood. In the setting of B12/folate deficiency, the binucleate erythroblast reflects dyserythropoiesis of megaloblastic anemia.

ddx.vs: MDS can show identical binucleate erythroblasts but typically has ring sideroblasts or clonal cytogenetics and normal B12/folate levels.
CDA II shows numerous binucleate late erythroblasts with normal B12/folate, a positive family history, and SEC23B mutation.
Overlap artifact shows two separate cytoplasmic outlines, whereas here both nuclei lie within one continuous cytoplasmic border.
